parameters.name: CreateTimeFrom
parameters.description: The earliest start time of a data quality scan run to include in the results. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: CreateTimeTo
parameters.description: The latest start time of a data quality scan run to include in the results. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: DataQualityScanId
parameters.description: The ID of the data quality scan.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description:
An object with advanced filter conditions. The following parameters are supported:

- `TaskInstanceId`: The ID of the task instance.

- `RunNumber`: The run number of the instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field and order for the results. The format is `FieldName Order`. The default order is ascending (Asc). Supported fields:

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

- Id (Desc/Asc)

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the data quality scan run. Valid values:

- Pass

- Running

- Error

- Fail

- Warn
